title: Butterfly holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD93D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF9F1C'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad2' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF6B9D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C44AFF'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- upper wings -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='30' rx='22' ry='18' fill='url(#wingGrad)' transform='rotate(-25 30 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='30' rx='22' ry='18' fill='url(#wingGrad)' transform='rotate(25 70 30)'/>

  <!-- lower wings -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='55' rx='17' ry='14' fill='url(#wingGrad2)' transform='rotate(20 32 55)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='55' rx='17' ry='14' fill='url(#wingGrad2)' transform='rotate(-20 68 55)'/>

  <!-- wing spots -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='4' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='4' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='54' r='3' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='54' r='3' fill='#FFD93D'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='5' ry='22' fill='#4A1E7A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='6' fill='#6B3FA0'/>

  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M48 22 Q42 12 38 10' stroke='#6B3FA0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 22 Q58 12 62 10' stroke='#6B3FA0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#FFD93D'/>

  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <path d='M46 48 Q40 58 42 66' stroke='#6B3FA0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 48 Q60 58 58 66' stroke='#6B3FA0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#9B6BD6'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#9B6BD6'/>

  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 78 C44 72 36 72 36 66 C36 61 41 58 46 61 C48 62 49 64 50 66 C51 64 52 62 54 61 C59 58 64 61 64 66 C64 72 56 72 50 78 Z' fill='#FF3B6B'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='66' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF8FAB' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
